 Company: WebBoost Solutions by UM
 



 Location: Remote
 



 Duration: 3 Months
 



 Employment Type: Full\\-Time Internship
 



 Stipend: Performance\\-Based, up to ₹7,500/\\-
 



  





 FOR COLLEGE STUDENTS ONLY

 ABOUT THE ROLE

 RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 • Collect, clean, and preprocess datasets for analysis
 



 • Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns and trends
 



 • Assist in developing and testing machine learning models
 



 • Apply basic statistical and analytical techniques to datasets

 • Willingness to learn and work on practical projects
 



  





 REQUIRED SKILLS

 PERKS \\& BENEFITS

 • Practical industry exposure and mentorship
 



 • Performance\\-based stipend up to ₹7,500/\\-

Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
   

  

 Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.
   

  

**Product Security Engineer**
**Summary**
 As part, a member of an R\\&D team, the Product Security Engineer works in close collaboration with the project \\& cybersecurity lead on assigned tasks and provides inputs to the design and testing of the new product/project. The engineer also provides guidance to software developers on their security issues, engages in design reviews, and helps resolve security issues.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Perform threat modeling, security risk assessments, vulnerability scanning, and penetration testing on various medical products and projects.
* Provide/Implement security guidance and best practices in the design and development lifecycle of various medical products.
* Prepare and document standard operating procedures and evaluate industry standards.
* Determines required tasks and completes them on time with no supervision
* Identifies and communicates potential risks with appropriate mitigations
* Supports other engineers on their designs, and also receives guidance from Specialists or Principal Engineer


**Experience**
* BS Degree (preferably in a technical discipline)
* 8\\+ years of engineering experience, or comparable experience
* 6\\+ years of security engineering experience
* Experience is preferred in/with vulnerability scanning, static code analysis, threat modeling, security risk assessments, penetration testing, cloud security (Azure), web application security, mobile device security
* Strong Organizational and communication skills
* Proficient problem\\-solving skills
* Strong Interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with others in a team environment
* Experience in the medical device industry and FDA Regulations is preferred
